control_review.observation: Inspected source-control-review.png: original native officer, cyan bare-body contour, blank anatomy guide and joint chains. Head axis follows original face; shoulders/forearms/knees/ankles follow original clothed pose. Hair, armor panels and boot thickness excluded. All 17 anatomical points are explicitly authored hidden values, not bare-body measurements. Forehead and cheek patches are the only manually selected visible skin observations. No generated quality or user acceptance inferred from this control review. Re-inspected after explicit two-pixel owner correction: body silhouette and pose unchanged; no pixel deletion; target controls retained. Re-inspected revised head/pelvis skin volume and source overlay: geometry unchanged; no facial marks or garment border; head highlights and pelvic lighting are authored skin clusters.

measurement_policy: Annotate visible surfaces in original source coordinates; preserve original fixed transform. Author hidden anatomy with bounded controls and explicit occluders. Hair top, armor edges and boot sole are not naked-body observations.
